events.description: Called with the whole new value each time the period, the comparison or its mode changes.
events.name: onChange

props.description: The group's accessible name; "Period" by default.
props.name: label

props.description: The current value, for a controlled picker; pair it with `onChange`.
props.name: value

props.description: The starting value, for an uncontrolled picker; the last 30 days with no comparison by default.
props.name: defaultValue

props.description: The presets offered, in order, before "Custom range"; a dashboard set by default.
props.name: presets

props.description: Offers the compare switch and its mode; on by default.
props.name: showComparison

props.description: The day the presets count from; today by default.
props.name: today

props.description: Refuses changes and shows the disabled style.
props.name: isDisabled
